newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones index edges up to record.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones index edges up to record.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average inched into record territory Monday, setting its fifth record close of the New Year, as late buying offset earlier weakness stemming from a drop in the shares of oil companies.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow rose 5.39 points to 6,709.18, surpassing Friday's record finish of 6,703.79. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on active volume of 446 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
